_comment: Fleet whitelabel config. COPY to ~/.config/fleet/config.json and edit. Both Fleet.app and bin/machine-card read this same file so the renderer and the emitter agree. Every key is optional — omit one and Fleet falls back to its historical default (Esa's layout). Paths may start with ~ or $HOME. Env vars FLEET_BIN_DIR / FLEET_QUEUE_DIR / FLEET_CONFIG override these at runtime.
_services_comment: Optional. Omit to use the built-in default registry. If present, this REPLACES the default list. Each entry: name (required), heartbeat (default <name>-heartbeat.json), inbox (a queue subdir to route files to, or null for read-only liveness), verb (human label). Bonjour LAN discovery works regardless of this list; services only gate the routable-skill buttons and the activity readout.
